title: A Veil for the Ember
author: Wendell Dunmore
blurb: Ines Oyelaran, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
